seoDescription: The terms of the Capital Row LLC text message program: what is sent, how often, and how to stop.

items.text: These terms apply to text messages sent by Capital Row LLC (“Capital Row”).

If you check the text message box on one of our forms and give a mobile number, you agree to receive marketing text messages from Capital Row LLC, such as market updates and event invitations. Consent is not a condition of any engagement or purchase.
Message and data rates may apply, according to your mobile plan.
Reply STOP to any message to opt out. You will receive one message confirming that you have been unsubscribed, and no further messages after it.
Reply HELP to any message, or write to team@thecapitalrow.com.
Carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages.
Text messaging originator opt-in data and consent will not be shared with any third parties, excluding aggregators and providers of the text message services. See the Privacy Policy.
Please do not send financial documents, patient records, protected health information or other confidential information by text message.
